blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-privacy-1 (E-mail address and display name written to application logs) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-privacy-2 (E-mail address sent to the third-party analytics vendor Beacon) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence: log.info("new signup email=%s name=%s id=%s", email, display_name, user_id)
findings.recommendation: Log only the opaque user id (e.g. `log.info("new signup id=%s", user_id)`); logs escape the erasure and retention rules of the users table (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation, Art. 5(1)(e) storage limitation).
findings.title: E-mail address and display name written to application logs

findings.recommendation: Drop `email` from the event and send only `user_id`; counting sign-ups needs no e-mail address (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation, Art. 25 data protection by default).
findings.title: E-mail address sent to the third-party analytics vendor Beacon

findings.evidence:
"""Product analytics, sent to the Beacon SaaS (beacon.example.com)."""

import requests

BEACON_URL = "https://beacon.example.com/v1/events"
findings.recommendation: State in the proposal that Beacon is a new processor, confirm a data processing agreement (GDPR Art. 28) and whether data leaves the EEA (Chapter V); question for the team, not a code fix.
findings.title: New processor Beacon not identified, nor its location or contract

findings.recommendation: Define how long member records are kept and how account deletion removes them, including log and analytics copies and backups (GDPR Art. 5(1)(e), Art. 17).
findings.title: No retention period nor erasure path for the stored e-mail and display name

findings.evidence: - [x] personal-data — collects e-mail addresses and display names
findings.recommendation: State in the proposal the purpose of each field and its lawful basis (GDPR Art. 6) — question for the controller.
findings.title: Purpose and lawful basis of the collected data not stated
